units.translation: he led me away to such deadly fortunes.
and I forbid the man-slaying, untimely fortunes.
the onrushing fortunes of life, beneficial.
he raised a paean over my god-beloved fortunes.
And Fortune the savior sat as she sailed (thus Casaubon for ναῦν θέλουσ᾽ [wishing the ship]).
The Erinyes in time, making him who is fortunate without justice dim through a change of fortune in the wear of life.
where I corrected ἀτιμαστῆρ᾽ ὅπως [as an avenger].

from an uncertain conjecture of Turnebus. In M βρότατος is written. Hermannus βοτὰ γᾶς [flocks of the land]. More probably Wecklein in Stud. Aesch. p. 166 βοτὰ τοῖς [flocks for them], to which the verb λάχοιεν [they might obtain], which follows, is suited.
thus may Zeus the avenger look upon him in his wrath.
or to punish him living as an avenger thus (τῶς in the first hand of M) a driver of men,
thus I too, fond of lamentation, waste away in Ionian strains.
thus may the city be well governed.
and may the flocks, thus, be prolific,
thus (τῶς M) she would not be dear.
